cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.
